title: Kissed Roasted Bowl
description: A delicious and unique Chinese-inspired bowl dish featuring roasted oats and kissed roasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: kissed roasted vegetables (such as carrots & broccoli)

instructions: Toss the kissed roasted vegetables in a bowl with a drizzle of sesame oil and roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes.
In a separate pan, toast the oats over medium heat for 5-7 minutes or until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the toasted oats, roasted vegetables, soy sauce, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
Top with sliced scallions and crumbled Slovakian cheese.
Optional: add any additional toppings of your choice.
